market_view: Calm regime (VIX 14.9, -13% over 5 days) but 10-year yields near 5% and bond-market inflation worries; oil is retreating on U.S.-Iran diplomacy hopes while chips rally hard.

oil_gas.catalyst: none (exit): 'Oil Prices Fall on U.S.-Iran Diplomacy Hopes' (WSJ), 'Oil prices settle lower as crude flows from Middle East improve' (Reuters), 'potential Saudi pipeline fix' (NBC News)
oil_gas.reasoning: The supply-shock thesis behind XOM is eroding: Middle East flows improving, diplomacy hopes and a possible Saudi pipeline fix are close to the handoff exit triggers. WTI 95.8, -4.5% on the day. Exit XOM and stay flat.

gold_miners.reasoning: No Fed pause; 10-year at 4.96% and firmer dollar. Record Chinese gold imports and fiscal-demand commentary are not a checkable new catalyst. Gold 17.6% below its high.

chips.catalyst: Carried from 2026-09-17: Jensen Huang said Nvidia will sell twice as many chips next year; reinforced today by 'AMD Just Joined the $1 Trillion Club' (Yahoo Finance) showing strong AI-chip demand.
chips.reasoning: Holding NVDA from 2026-09-17 (exit about 2026-10-01). No guidance cut, export rule or sharp rate spike. Semis +10% in 5 days, so much is priced; bond-market pressure is the main risk.

pharma.catalyst: none qualifying: 'Eli Lilly CEO says 700,000 new seniors have started GLP-1s after Medicare coverage, and 70% are on Lilly drugs' (CNBC) is a CEO comment, not an approval or data release
pharma.reasoning: Encouraging LLY demand comment, but soft and partly priced (LLY +1% day, +2.3% over 5 days). Not strong enough for a long under the catalyst rule.

copper_uranium.catalyst: none: 'Copper Rises for a Sixth Day Toward Record on China Tightness' (Bloomberg) describes a move already made, not a named outage
copper_uranium.reasoning: Copper +5.6% over 5 days, near its high; the move is priced. No named mine outage. Uranium headlines lean supply-ample.

would_change_my_mind: A collapse of U.S.-Iran talks or a renewed Gulf supply outage (re-enter XOM); a 10-year spike well above 5% or an export rule (exit NVDA); an LLY approval or trial readout.

handoff.what_changed: WTI fell to 95.8 (-4.5% on the day, -5.5% over 5 days) on U.S.-Iran diplomacy hopes, improving Middle East crude flows and a possible Saudi pipeline fix, so XOM was exited. Chips rallied strongly (semis +10% over 5 days, AMD reached $1 trillion); NVDA is held. Lilly CEO said 70% of 700,000 new Medicare GLP-1 starts are on Lilly drugs.
